title: Beautiful quality quilt
text: Beautiful quality quilt. This quilt is beautiful and the colors are just like it shows on the website.  It is excellent quality, washes well without fading and is not too heavy or thick.  The king size actually fits nicely and is not too short.  I purchased this for Spring/Summer and think this will be just fine.  You could also use this in winter by adding an extra blanket between sheets and quilt.
